title: XOS status
description: Availability of XOS, checked from outside every few minutes. This page updates when a failure is confirmed or ends, and about once an hour. A component marked No data is not checked yet.

overall.degraded: Some systems are slower than normal or missed a check. We are watching them.
overall.outage: Some systems are unavailable. We are working on it; updates appear below.
overall.unknown: Status checks have not reported yet. Checks run every five minutes; refresh this page shortly.
overall.partial: The components we check are operational. Those marked No data are not checked yet.

uptimeUnknown: No checks recorded in the last {days} days
historyLabel: Daily history for {component} in {region}, oldest first

incidents.heading: Incidents in the last 14 days
incidents.empty: No incidents in the last 14 days. If something is not working for you, report it from Help in Atlas or Gateway.

footer: Measured by synthetic checks against the live service. One failed check shows as Degraded; two in a row show as Outage. Target: 99.9 percent monthly availability for Atlas, Gateway and the API.
